name: Ballpit
description: Full-container WebGL2 ball pit where hundreds of shaded spheres fall, collide and pile up with physics, follow the cursor, can be grabbed and thrown, and burst apart on click.
contents: Wrapper div containing a single WebGL2 canvas
Instanced sphere renderer with custom GLSL shaders (studio lighting, ambient shading, tone mapping)
Custom 3D physics: sphere collisions, walls, grid broadphase, cursor ball and grab-and-throw
behavior: Spheres drop in from above on mount and settle into a pile, or glide out from the center when gravity is near zero
A cursor sphere follows the pointer and pushes balls around while the pointer is inside the container
Pressing on a ball grabs it, releasing throws it with the pointer velocity
A quick click without dragging triggers a burst that blasts nearby balls away and flashes the light
A point light follows the cursor and rests above the pile when the pointer leaves
Rendering pauses when offscreen, tab hidden or the scene is at rest, and wakes on interaction
Reduced motion preference disables the intro drop, drift and click burst
editableByProps: Ball count (1 to 4000), colors palette, min and max size
Surface material (satin, matte, gloss, frosted, metal)
Gravity, friction, bounciness, depth of the pit and ambient drift
Cursor ball on or off and its size, grab and throw, click burst
Light color and intensity, exposure, contact shadow strength
Intro drop on or off, pixel ratio, container className and style

needsCodeEdit.change: Add or tune the material looks
Change camera field of view or distance
Add other click effects besides burst
Change the studio reflection lighting or tone mapping
needsCodeEdit.where: studio and aces functions in the FRAGMENT shader

needsCodeEdit.change: Use a different color for the cursor ball
needsCodeEdit.where: cursor branch of the draw function (uses palette[0])

fixed: Requires WebGL2; renders nothing if the context or shader fails
Container must have a height, it fills its parent with w-full h-full and overflow hidden
Listens for pointer events on window and document, so interaction works even when other elements overlay the container (links and buttons are ignored)
Pointer down on a ball calls preventDefault for mouse input
Only the 'burst' value of clickEffect has an effect, any other value disables click bursts
lightIntensity values above 20 are divided by 200
Canvas pixel ratio is capped at 2
Canvas background is transparent, balls are lit by a fixed studio environment
Cursor ball uses the first color of the colors palette
Aspect ratio above 1.5 is clamped and balls shrink on small containers (fit factor 0.4 to 1)
Physics settings are read live, but changes to dpr trigger a resize and count changes add or remove balls
Releases the WebGL context on unmount
